---
title: "arsgrammatica"
---

A python package leveraging LLMs with [dspy](https://dspy.ai) to analyze the syntax of passages of Latin..

`arsgrammatica` offers an alternative analytic scheme to [Universal Dependencies](https://universaldependencies.org), designed to describe Latin syntax in familiar terms that are convenient for research and teaching. Released under the [GNU General Public License v3 or later](LICENSE). 

| | Learning the package | Using the package |

| **Understanding** | [Modelling Latin syntax](./concepts/)   | See [reference information](./reference/) (including API documentation for all exported functions) |


## Related work

- [grammatike](https://github.com/neelsmith/grammatike): a parallel Python package for analyzing passages of ancient Greek with LMs
- [diqduq](https://github.com/neelsmith/diqduq): a parallel Python package for analyzing passages of Biblical Hebrew with LMs
- [aat](https://github.com/neelsmith/aat) : Agent-Action-Target model, a reductive model of natural-language syntax
